item.title: CBK okays transfer of Access Bank Kenya assets, liabilities to NBK
item.dc:creator: KEVIN ROTICH
item.description: CBK approved Access Bank PLC’s 100 percent acquisition of NBK in April 2025.
item.content:encoded:
NAIROBI, Kenya, Sept 23 – The Central Bank of Kenya (CBK) has approved the transfer of Access Bank Kenya’s business.

NBK was incorporated in 1968 and was fully acquired by KCB Group in 2019 before being sold to Access Bank.

item.title: StanChart falls to tier two bank, CBK data shows
item.description: The lender’s total net asset market share also declined.
item.content:encoded:
Standard Chartered Bank Kenya has moved from tier one to tier two. StanChart began paying former employees.

KCB Kenya remained the largest tier one bank. Equity Bank Kenya followed. Other tier one banks were Co-operative Bank of Kenya, NCBA Bank Kenya, Absa Bank Kenya, Stanbic Bank Kenya, I&M Bank and Diamond Trust Bank Kenya.

item.title: Number of ATMs falls amid shift to digital banking
item.content:encoded: CBK attributed the decline to competition from mobile money services such as Safaricom’s M-Pesa. The shilling was stable and inflation eased.
